Thought: The glass transition temperature (Tg) is related to the rigidity and structure of the polymer. Polymers with rigid backbones, aromatic rings, and strong intermolecular forces tend to have higher Tg values. PC has the highest Tg due to its rigid aromatic structure with carbonate linkages. PET also has a high Tg due to aromatic rings, but not as high as PC. PP has a much lower Tg because it's a simple aliphatic polymer with some methyl side groups. PE has the lowest Tg because it's the simplest flexible hydrocarbon chain with minimal steric hindrance.
